_comment: CDriveSentinel config. data_root is relative to the project folder (where src/ lives), so the project works on any drive/machine. Keep outputs off the monitored volume when a second drive exists; on a single-drive machine the data subtree is auto-excluded from scans to avoid self-stimulation. Edit scope to narrow the scan and speed it up.

wiztree.note: P1 diffs by NTFS file ID; WizTree CSV has no FRN column, so P1 uses the built-in scanner.
